name: slowtrail
description: 星河逐影 (SlowTrail) - MySQL 慢 SQL 透视分析平台

scripts.dev:electron: concurrently --raw "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run electron:wait"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:electron
scripts.pack: npm run clean:release && npm run build:all && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist: npm run clean:release && npm run build:all && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:all: npm run clean:release && npm run build:all && electron-builder --win --mac --linux --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run clean:release && npm run build:all && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:mac: npm run clean:release && npm run build:all && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:linux: npm run clean:release && npm run build:all && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.config.js
